name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
description: NIST CSF 2.0 — baseline reference (paraphrased subcategory subset).

controls.title: Hardware and system inventory
controls.description: Inventories of hardware and systems managed by the organization are maintained.

checks.rationale: The maintained asset inventory is the ID.AM artifact.

controls.title: Vulnerability identification
controls.description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded.

checks.rationale: Completed scans identify and record vulnerabilities.
Coverage proves identification spans the asset base.

controls.title: Access permissions and least privilege
controls.description: Access permissions incorporate least privilege and separation of duties.

controls.title: Network and asset monitoring
controls.description: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.

checks.rationale: Active recurring schedules evidence continuous monitoring.
Recent discovery runs prove monitoring operates.

controls.title: Incident response execution
controls.description: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared.

checks.rationale: A published IR plan is the precondition for RS.MA.

controls.title: Recovery plan execution
controls.description: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated.

checks.rationale: Tested recovery exercises evidence executable recovery.
